ammonia.reason: No surface flora, low urease and deamination; little NH3 vs bloomy/washed cheeses.

animal_barnyard.reason: Raw cow milk and long rind ripening give faint p-cresol/indole, no manure defect.

bitter.reason: Lactobacillus helveticus peptidases clear hydrophobic peptides, low bitterness at pH 5.68.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, mold none; 2-heptanone 0.45 ppm below blue threshold.

browning.reason: pH 5.68 with residual galactose and free amino acids gives good Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Streptococcus thermophilus citrate metabolism yields diacetyl 0.8 ppm plus acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis moderate 2-7 g/kg FFA; butanoic 112-392 mg/kg + 3-methylbutanoic 2.7 mg/kg.

creaminess.reason: 31.25% fat and cooked-pressed elastic paste gives smooth mouthfeel, not bloomy cream.

crumbliness.reason: Cooked, pressed, elastic curd at 36.7% moisture with propionic eyes resists fracture.

firmness.reason: Low moisture 36.7%, high cook 50-53C and long press create firm elastic alpine body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from aromatic amino acid catabolism by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Propionibacterium esterification yields ethyl butanoate 0.6 ppm, mild pineapple-apple.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only, no caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids; hexanoic low.

malty_nutty.reason: Propionibacterium freudenreichii converts lactate to propionic 1.7-6.1 g/kg plus 2-methylbutanal 0.42 ppm, classic hazelnut.

melt.reason: pH 5.68, low salt 0.8% and intact para-casein network flow well when heated, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No white mold or 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one; indoor rind, no earthy defect.

oil_off.reason: 31.25% fat, cooked curd releases moderate free oil on melting, less than cheddar/grana.

smoky.reason: Smoked false, no wood-smoke phenols like guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 1.4-1.5 g/kg plus propionic up to 6.1 g/kg from hot-room 23C propionic fermentation.

stretch.reason: Rennet-cooked, non-pasta-filata curd; stretched false, no aligned curd fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: High cook and methionine catabolism give dimethyl sulfide 0.107 ppm, mild cooked-corn.

sweet.reason: Low salt 0.8%, propionate and proline-rich peptides plus low acidity pH 5.68 perceived sweet.

umami.reason: 6-month proteolysis by L. helveticus releases glutamate, moderate savory without crystals.
